zh.summary: 讓接手者依 README 找到入口、重建環境、完成驗收，也清楚知道原型的限制與停止方式。
objectives: 寫出可操作的環境、命令與驗收說明。
區分預期結果、作者實測與接手者重現。
把限制、復原與清理方式納入交接。

readingGuide.goal: 寫出可操作的環境、命令與驗收說明。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 指定版本的工作坊或學員專案、新目錄與獨立環境；有同儕時使用其自有環境。
readingGuide.route: 先理解情境與原理，再對照工作坊檔案，最後留下可核對的操作與審查紀錄。
readingGuide.output: README.md 與重現紀錄能讓接手者知道如何啟動、驗收及收工。

sections.heading: 以第一次接手的人為讀者
paragraphs: README 是專案入口。接手者應能知道這份程式幫誰做什麼、從哪個目錄啟動、需要哪些版本及如何判斷結果。只寫「執行 app.py」會漏掉環境、路徑與操作情境。
README 的命令必須對應交付檔案。若學員 app.py 在專案根目錄，就改成實際路徑；不要原樣貼上教師 reference/ 命令卻交付不同結構。

sections.heading: 像把工具與可照做的使用說明一起交出
paragraphs: 工具放進箱子還不夠，接手者需要知道接線、啟動、正常狀態與收工方式。說明若只記製作者當時的習慣，另一個人仍得重新猜測。
軟體交接也要保留前置條件與結果邊界。作者自己能啟動、另一個乾淨環境能重建、同儕能獨立使用，是不同證據，不互相替代。

sections.heading: 對照工作坊的完整 README 範例
paragraphs: 以下以整個工作坊解壓根目錄為起點，示範如何啟動教師參考解答。學員交接自己的專案時，保留這些資訊類別，改成自己實際檔案及已確認需求。
這裡列的是預期行為與操作方法，沒有替你填入尚未執行的結果。requirements.txt 固定直接套件版本，不代表所有平台及間接依賴已驗證。

blocks.heading: README.md｜工作坊重現範例
paragraphs: 命令逐條執行；Windows 啟用方式另依說明，未經實測的平台保留待驗。
blocks.code:
# 合成收件資料完整性檢核｜工作坊重現範例

## 用途與範圍
本機單人、只用合成資料；檢查申請編號、申請人代號、文件類型。
去除首尾空白後為 1–80 字元。完整僅代表教學欄位，不代表正式受理。
沒有登入、多人授權、持久資料庫、外部 API 或正式部署。

## 環境與檔案
Python 3.11／3.12；依 requirements.txt 安裝固定直接依賴。
Streamlit 1.51.0、pytest 8.4.2；未宣稱所有間接依賴鎖定。
在解壓根目錄可見 requirements.txt、starter/、slices/、reference/。

## 建立環境（POSIX shell，從解壓根目錄）
python3 -m venv .venv
. .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
python --version
python -m streamlit version
python -m pytest --version

## 測試及啟動參考解答
cd reference
python -m pytest -q
python -m streamlit run app.py --server.address 127.0.0.1
瀏覽器開啟終端機顯示的本機網址；Ctrl+C 停止服務。
Windows PowerShell 從解壓根目錄啟用的命令為 .venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1；依既有政策操作。

## 最小操作驗收
填 SYN-001、DEMO-A，文件類型空白時按檢查：提示缺漏，無完整下載。
補上「合成申請表」再檢查：可預覽及下載 JSON。
清空文件類型並提交變更：舊成功與下載失效，補值後需重查。
讀取下載檔，核對三欄、status、scope 與中文內容。

## 結果、限制與清理
另記實際日期、平台、版本、命令、退出結果與尚未執行項目。
AppTest 不取代真實瀏覽器下載或真人任務觀察。
下載檔在操作者裝置，關閉頁面不代表已刪除。
結束後停止本次服務，依需要保留或刪除合成下載。
多人版需先確認身分、授權、儲存與維運要求，再設計及驗證。

sections.heading: 乾淨環境用來找出隱藏前提
paragraphs: 請另一位同儕取得指定提交或同一版資源包，在新目錄建立自己的虛擬環境，依 README 執行，不複製作者現有 .venv。記錄需要補問或自行猜測的地方，再修正文件。
沒有同儕時，可先由作者在獨立目錄重建，找出漏掉的依賴與路徑；把結果標成作者重建，仍保留真人交接待驗，不能代填別人的通過。

sections.heading: 限制要能指向下一個決策
paragraphs: 寫明單人本機、合成資料、沒有登入與多人授權、沒有持久資料庫或正式部署。若要十人共用，下一步先確認資料存取、保存、備份與維運，不只換一個啟動位址。
出錯時說明先停止哪個服務、保存哪些紀錄與如何回到已知版本；下載檔在裝置上另行管理。不要宣稱關閉網頁就安全刪除所有資料。

blocks.caption: 表 1｜交接文件應分清的欄位
rows: 哪些輸入應成功或被拒絕
實際平台、版本、命令及結果
誰在何種環境依文件完成，是否獲協助
尚未實作的控制與尚未測量的情境
服務停止、檔案保留與可回復版本

sections.heading: 用實際重現修正文件
paragraphs: 若接手者遇到 import 錯誤，先確認工作目錄、環境與檔案是否齊全；不要要求對方降低系統政策或安裝與任務無關的套件來掩蓋問題。
交接後每次改動入口、依賴、規則或輸出，連同 README 與驗收紀錄更新。下一篇以這些作品組織成果展示，讓每一個完成主張都能回到證據。

exercise.environment: 指定版本的工作坊或學員專案、新目錄與獨立環境；有同儕時使用其自有環境。
steps: 依範例改寫 README，使路徑、依賴與實際交付一致。
從新目錄重建、測試、啟動並完成缺漏、補正與變更驗收，記錄需要協助之處。
補齊限制、停止與復原資訊；分開標記作者重建與真人交接。
exercise.expected: README.md 與重現紀錄能讓接手者知道如何啟動、驗收及收工。
exercise.check: 不複製既有虛擬環境，不把預期輸出或作者重建當成同儕實測。
exercise.cleanup: 停止本次啟動的服務，保留合成作品、Diff 與實際結果；不要覆蓋其他工作或留下真實資料。

en.summary: Help successors locate the entry point, rebuild the environment and perform acceptance from README, with clear prototype limits and shutdown steps.
objectives: Write actionable environment, command and acceptance instructions.
Separate expected results, author checks and successor reproduction.
Include limitations, recovery and cleanup in handoff.

readingGuide.goal: Write actionable environment, command and acceptance instructions.
readingGuide.startingPoint: A specified workshop/project version, a new directory and separate environment; a peer uses their own environment when available.
readingGuide.route: Understand the situation and principles, compare the workshop files, then retain verifiable operation and review records.
readingGuide.output: README.md and reproduction records explaining startup, acceptance and shutdown.

sections.heading: Write for Someone Taking Over for the First Time
paragraphs: README is the project entry point. Successors need purpose, users, starting directory, versions and observable outcomes. “Run app.py” omits environment, paths and task scenarios.
Commands must match delivered files. If your app.py is at project root, use that path; do not copy teacher reference/ commands while delivering a different structure.

sections.heading: Deliver the Tool with Instructions People Can Follow
paragraphs: Putting a tool in a box is insufficient: the recipient needs connections, startup, normal status and shutdown instructions. Notes covering only the maker’s habits leave others guessing.
Software handoff also preserves prerequisites and result limits. Author startup, rebuilding in a clean environment and independent peer operation are distinct evidence.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | README Supports the Full Operating Route
blocks.description: Organize for the successor, with each step traceable to files or records.

items.title: Rebuild
items.body: Dependencies, environment creation and actual entry point.

items.title: Accept
items.body: Commands, synthetic input and observable results.

sections.heading: A Complete README Example for the Workshop
paragraphs: The example starts from the extracted workshop root and runs the teacher reference. When handing over your own project, retain these information categories but substitute actual files and confirmed requirements.
These are instructions and expected behavior, not prefilled execution results. requirements.txt pins direct packages without establishing every platform or transitive dependency.

blocks.heading: README.md | Workshop Reproduction Example
paragraphs: Execute commands individually; follow the separate Windows activation instructions and leave untested platforms pending. The unchanged Traditional Chinese example covers local single-user synthetic input, three trimmed 1–80-character fields and no official acceptance; absent login/multiuser/database/API/deployment; Python 3.11/3.12 with Streamlit 1.51.0/pytest 8.4.2; root directories; a new venv and installation; reference tests/startup and Ctrl+C; omission, correction, change invalidation and JSON inspection; actual version/result records, separate human checks, device downloads and future shared-version decisions.

sections.heading: Use a Clean Environment to Reveal Hidden Assumptions
paragraphs: Ask a peer to obtain the specified commit or resource-package version, create a new environment and follow README without copying the author’s .venv. Record questions and guesses, then improve the instructions.

Without a peer, the author can rebuild in another directory to find missing dependencies or paths. Label it author reproduction and keep human handoff pending; do not substitute it for someone else’s result.

sections.heading: Make Each Limitation Point to a Decision
paragraphs: State local single-user execution, synthetic data, absent login/multiuser authorization, no persistent database and no production deployment. For ten users, first address access, retention, backup and operations rather than only changing the bind address.

Explain which service to stop on failure, which records to retain and how to recover a known version. Downloaded files are managed separately on the device; closing the page does not securely erase all data.

blocks.caption: Table 1 | Separate These Handoff Fields
rows: Inputs that should succeed or be rejected.
Actual platform, versions, commands and results.
Who followed the instructions in which environment, with any assistance.
Service shutdown, retained files and recoverable version.

sections.heading: Improve Instructions Through Actual Reproduction
paragraphs: For import errors, check working directory, environment and complete files first. Do not ask recipients to lower system policy or install unrelated packages to hide problems.
After handoff, update README and acceptance records whenever entry points, dependencies, rules or output change. The next lesson uses these artifacts to connect demonstration claims to evidence.

exercise.environment: A specified workshop/project version, a new directory and separate environment; a peer uses their own environment when available.
steps: Adapt README so paths and dependencies match actual delivery.
Rebuild, test and start in a new directory; perform omission, correction and change acceptance and record assistance needed.
Complete limitations, shutdown and recovery information, separating author reproduction from human handoff.
exercise.expected: README.md and reproduction records explaining startup, acceptance and shutdown.
exercise.check: Copy no existing virtual environment. Expected output or author reproduction is not peer execution.
exercise.cleanup: Stop only services you started for this exercise. Keep synthetic work, diffs and actual results; preserve other work and leave no real data.

zh.prompt: README 的命令應以什麼為準？
options: 實際交付的版本與目錄結構
The version and directory structure actually delivered.
rationales: Dependencies and starting location are also needed.

zh.prompt: 作者在新環境重建成功，可以記成什麼？
options: 作者重建成功，同儕交接仍待驗
rationales: 不是另一位讀者的證據。

en.prompt: The author rebuilt successfully in a new environment. What may be recorded?
options: Author reproduction succeeded; peer handoff remains pending.
A production multiuser service is ready.
rationales: That is not evidence from another reader.
Preserve the actual actor and scope.

zh.prompt: 為何要寫停止與下載清理方式？
options: 交接包含執行後資源與檔案的管理
rationales: 仍需真實刪除機制與證據。
知道服務與資料各由誰管理。

en.prompt: Why document shutdown and download cleanup?
options: Handoff includes managing resources and files after execution.
rationales: Actual deletion mechanisms/evidence are still needed.
They are part of the operation.
Identify responsibility for services and data.
